items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source Security Update
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for these issues.

items.title: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution in Mirasvit Cache Warmer
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a popular Magento extension, allowing remote code execution via a crafted cookie. Mirasvit released a patched version (1.11.12) on May 25, 2026.

items.title: Adobe Commerce Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
items.summary: This incorrect authorization flaw in Adobe Commerce allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to bypass security checks and gain unauthorized write access. The vulnerability has a CVSS 3.1 base score of 7.5.

items.title: Adobe Commerce Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
items.summary: This denial-of-service vulnerability in Adobe Commerce stems from a dependency on a vulnerable third-party component. Successful exploitation can crash the application, disrupting storefront and administrative availability.

items.title: Unrestricted File Upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce REST API
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical flaw in Magento's REST API that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files disguised as images. Adobe released a fix in Magento 2.4.9, but older supported versions remain vulnerable without specific mitigation.

items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source Security Update
items.summary: This security update addresses critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including security feature bypass, application denial-of-service, privilege escalation, arbitrary code execution, and arbitrary file system read. Adobe recommends users update their installations to the newest version.

items.title: Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
items.summary: This high-severity vulnerability, addressed in APSB26-05, could lead to privilege escalation in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. It was among 19 flaws fixed in the update.

items.title: Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
items.summary: A high-severity privilege escalation vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source was resolved as part of the APSB26-05 security bulletin. Users are urged to apply patches promptly.

items.title: Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
items.summary: This high-severity flaw, patched in APSB26-05, could allow an attacker to gain elevated privileges within Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Adobe recommends immediate patching.

items.title: Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
items.summary: Addressed in APSB26-05, this high-severity vulnerability enables privilege escalation in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. It is one of several critical and important issues resolved in the update.

items.title: Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
items.summary: This high-severity privilege escalation vulnerability was fixed in the APSB26-05 security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Successful exploitation could lead to unauthorized access.

items.title: Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability
items.summary: A high-severity security feature bypass vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source was resolved with the release of APSB26-05. This flaw could allow attackers to circumvent security controls.
